model_classification: balanced positive-sequence synchronous-dq averaged electromagnetic-transient model
explicit_non_claims: not a protection-coordination or insulation-coordination study
not field-calibrated and not validated against measurements
not MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, EMTP, PowerFactory, PLECS, RTDS, Typhoon HIL or OPAL-RT evidence

analytical_baseline.description: closed-form high-voltage receiving-end solution for the same two-bus constant-P/Q operating point with the declared PCC shunt omitted

step_sensitivity.reference_definition: same equations and events at the declared finer fixed step
step_sensitivity.selection_rule: 25 us and every tested finer step must meet waveform and extrema tolerances; the 50 us run is retained as a coarse-step sensitivity result

schedule_feedback.screen: highest-import interval, loss of scheduled BESS discharge
schedule_feedback.feedback_reason: BESS-trip contingency missed the dynamic voltage/current screen; rerun remaining-horizon scheduling with the recommended depot-import bound.
